name: aiand-copilot-chat
description: Use hosted ai& models in GitHub Copilot Chat with your ai& API key.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestions.description: Experimental. Provide ghost-text inline completions while typing, powered by the ai& gateway with reasoning_effort none. Credentials, prompts, and document context are never logged.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsModel.description: Model id used for inline completions. Defaults to the low-latency flash tier.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsChatInput.description: Also offer inline completions inside the Copilot Chat prompt box.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsDebounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds between typing and an inline completion request.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for inline completions.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsPrefixLine.description: Lines of document context sent before the cursor.

aiandCopilot.inlineSuggestionsSuffixChar.description: Characters of document context sent after the cursor.

enumDescriptions: Use less reasoning for lower latency and cost.
Balance reasoning depth, latency, and cost.
Use deeper reasoning for complex tasks.
aiandCopilot.reasoningEffort.description: Default ai& reasoning effort. A Copilot model-picker selection overrides this value.

aiandCopilot.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens requested from ai& hosted models. Use 0 to reserve up to 32,768 response tokens. Positive values are capped by the model output capability and context window.

aiandCopilot.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration of an ai& inference request in seconds.

aiandCopilot.streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time without receiving streamed ai& response data before aborting a request.

aiandCopilot.catalogCacheMinutes.description: How long the ai& hosted-model catalog is reused before refreshing.

aiandCopilot.showUsageStatusBar.description: Show the active ai& account credit balance and locally tracked request activity in the status bar.

aiandCopilot.debugLogging.description: Log request, stream, usage, and model-discovery metadata to the ai& output channel. Prompts and API keys are never logged.

apiKey.title: ai& API Key
apiKey.description: API key for this ai& provider entry. VS Code stores configured secrets securely.
